svg.text: THE LONG ISLAND (full-size cypress + pine on the creek)
1960s paper subdivision: sand roads + 0.7 m ditches
THE PLAIN (TERRACE 3, z +28): PYGMY FOREST, 1.2-1.6 m
fog front advances east ~0.6 m/s; Scarp B at ~19 min
GRIMBLE (easter egg): in from the sea with the fog, wades the Plain
N edge: 2.4 m deer fence (y 480), fresh clear-cut beyond
S edge: brush-choked creek draw (y -480), unwalkable
wildcard concept: a pygmy forest on lifted sea terraces (Mendocino coast). Metres, estate centre = (0,0), north up, heights relative to the lawn.
Barrens 0.3-0.8 m: seen standing or crouched
Pygmy 1.2-1.6 m: crouched hidden, standing = peek
Thicket 2-4 m: hidden standing, slow + loud
Tall 15-40 m: redwood / Bishop pine / cypress, real cover
sand road + ditch (walk hidden, straight sightline)
rifle positions (arrive ~5 min, by the Ridge Road)
fog front (time since leaving the gate)
Routes (all from the gate to the Ridge Road):
A the Plain: windrow, the Stumps, ditches, the Notch. Shortest, sight-and-sound.
B the Incline: rail grade, trestle, Long Island, creek head. Cover, dark, the Grimble.
C the Strip: drive, Fork, road cut, 640 m runway, hangar, switchbacks. Fast, naked.
Elevations: T1 -25, T2 0 (estate), T3 +28 (the Plain), T4 +55 (Ridge Road).
